# CRAFT GTM MCP connector

> CRAFT GTM gives Claude eight planning tools for B2B go-to-market work: a product-market fit scorecard, launch plans, customer interview guides, retention playbooks, partner programs, crisis playbooks, competitive battle cards and a CRAFT review of any GTM document. Every tool turns the details you give it into a structured plan.

- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Setup and tools: https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/
- Privacy policy: https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/privacy.html
- Local npm package: @shashwatgtmalpha/craft-gtm-mcp
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-gtm-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)

## Tools

- PMF Scorecard (pmf_scorecard): Generate a Product-Market Fit scorecard. Parses the metrics you provide (MRR, churn, NPS, CAC, LTV, retention, activation and similar) and scores each dimension against built-in benchmark ranges.
- Launch Commander (launch_commander): Generate a context-aware launch plan. Have a date? Get a detailed timeline. Still planning? Enter 'TBD' or 'Q2 2025' for a flexible plan.
- Customer Interview Kit (customer_interview_kit): Generate interview guides that ADAPT based on interview type, industry, and product complexity. Includes synthesis templates.
- Retention Playbook (retention_playbook): Generate retention strategies. Has DISCOVERY MODE - if you don't know WHY people churn, get a churn analysis framework first.
- Partner Architect (partner_architect): Design partner programs that ADAPT based on partner model type. Different structures for resellers vs referrals vs integrations vs affiliates.
- Crisis Planner (crisis_planner): Generate crisis playbooks. Know your risks? Get specific playbooks. Not sure what to plan for? We'll suggest the top crises for your industry.
- Competitive Intel (competitive_intel): Generate battle cards. If you know your strengths/weaknesses, get complete battle cards. If you only know competitors and win/loss stories, we'll derive your positioning.
- CRAFT GTM Analyzer (craft_gtm_analyzer): Analyze a GTM document against the CRAFT framework. Parses the content, identifies gaps, scores each dimension and suggests sections to add.

## Questions and answers

### What is CRAFT GTM?

CRAFT GTM gives Claude eight planning tools for B2B go-to-market work: a product-market fit scorecard, launch plans, customer interview guides, retention playbooks, partner programs, crisis playbooks, competitive battle cards and a CRAFT review of any GTM document. Every tool turns the details you give it into a structured plan.

### How do I connect CRAFT GTM to Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, then Add custom connector. Name it CRAFT GTM, paste the server URL https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/mcp, choose no sign-in and select Add. In Claude Code run: claude mcp add --transport http craft-gtm https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/mcp

### Does CRAFT GTM need an account, and what does it cost?

No account or sign-in is needed, and there is no charge. The server is public and every tool is read-only.

### Which tools does CRAFT GTM include?

8 tools: PMF Scorecard, Launch Commander, Customer Interview Kit, Retention Playbook, Partner Architect, Crisis Planner, Competitive Intel, CRAFT GTM Analyzer.

### What data does CRAFT GTM keep?

None. Each call is answered from the inputs you give it, and the server stores and logs nothing. Netlify, the host, keeps its own request logs. See the privacy policy.

### Can I run CRAFT GTM on my own computer?

Yes. Run npx -y @shashwatgtmalpha/craft-gtm-mcp to use the same tools locally over stdio; nothing is sent to us.

### Who built CRAFT GTM?

Shashwat Ghosh, founder of Helix GTM Consulting, a GTM Alpha consultant, AI GTM expert and fractional CMO with 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience.
